integrity: Underlying concentration Green function and qualitative delay are prior art; only the two-term uniform uptake peak-lag crossover is reviewed as the mathematical addition. Numerical tests supplement an explicit analytic argument. No independent validation or novelty certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous infinite three-dimensional medium, fixed positive source-detector separation, linear first-order loss. Source first issued in a 1997 print issue with no verified exact print day; its open online archive posting date is 2006-03-27. Uniformity is at fixed a,p as T/a tends to infinity and across k>=0.
title: Uniform uptake crossover for the post-release peak of a diffusing point-source pulse
